property_summary: For all inputs, calling initialize(...) on the correct contract reverts if _feeRate > 5000 (so feeRate on-chain is never > 5000 after initialize), whereas the mutant accepts any _feeRate allowing feeRate > 5000 for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the validation that prevents a feeRate > 5000 by changing the require revert check to allow any feeRate (deleted the FeeRateTooHigh check).
